messages.text: Q-10 owner step is still open. Run 'pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/questionnaireFile.test.ts' again before handing over the example: Playwright empties test-results/ at the start of each run. The owner sends the file by Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp to another computer, opens it in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, answers, saves, and notes any antivirus or e-mail block. Then record the matrix with aioson dossier:add-finding . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento --agent=dev --section="Q-10".

Packaging: questionnaireFile.ts reads questionnaireClient.js and questionnaireStyles.css next to itself at run time (import.meta.url, L169-170). Both files must ship with server/ in the packaged app. Confirm with node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs. Not verified here.

Process incident reported by the implementer (phase-6-backend-questionnaire-file): a cleanup command stopped about 19 processes matched by name pattern (browser-smoke.mts, ms-playwright). Some may have belonged to another unit between about 20:00 and 20:05 local on 2026-10-25. If another unit reported an unexplained hang or lost shell in that window, re-run its check. No project file was affected. Not reproduced by this review.

Implementer decision for the owner to confirm: the prototype intro line 'suas respostas ficam guardadas neste computador' was not used. The approved PRD copy says answers are lost if the page closes before saving, so the file stores nothing (no storage APIs; beforeunload warns while unsaved). Small additions beyond the approved copy: 'Baixar de novo', 'Voltar as respostas', a noscript line, and base-uri 'none' in the CSP.

IF-004: the .fitpulse answers file is JSON with format 'fitpulse-answers' (ANSWERS_FILE_FORMAT), formatVersion 1, questionnaireVersion 1, company {id, name}, savedAt (ISO-8601), answers and calculator. The PATCH step must take answers and calculator from the file and validate them with diagnosisPatchSchema; the verified test passes only those two keys. Check company.id against the target company before applying (AC-ra-52).

The dialog cannot import server code. The approved client message is buildClientMessage(companyName, brandName) in server/questionnaire/questionnaireFile.ts. questionnaireService should return it (for example as a message field of POST /api/companies/:id/questionnaire) so SendQuestionnaireDialog shows exactly that text.
